title: RemoteEnabledPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'remote.enabled'. STATE.md "Loombre Remote — embedded WireGuard + three-path wizard + reachability proof + posture card" (R1/R9): emitted when the embedded userspace WireGuard listener (packages/wg-native) is enabled — the server keypair was generated and the in-process listener opened. R9's no-secrets rule: never carries the server private key, the listen port, or any keyring reference — those are read-side facts (GET /admin/remote/wireguard/status), not audit-event payload. ADMIN-ONLY delivery (packages/shared/src/admin-only-event-types.ts) — instance-configuration/security-posture data, same posture as plugin.enabled.
